journey.name: Presets
journey.description: Save the current settings as a preset, apply a built-in one, then delete the saved one. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval), whose default workout matches no preset.

actions.action: Verify that "Built-in" and "Yours" groups are shown, and "Yours" says "Presets you save show up here."
Tap the "Save current settings as a preset" button
Verify that a dialog titled "Save as preset" is shown
Verify that a "Journey" preset is shown under "Yours"
Verify that the Timer tab is shown and its summary card is labelled "Tabata"
Verify that "Journey" is no longer shown and "Yours" says "Presets you save show up here."
